results.title: AGent Energy Closes Series Seed to Unlock 200+ GW of Behind-the-Meter Generation Across Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Sectors
results.author: AGent Energy
highlights:
Round Co-Led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures with Participation from Intrepid Investment Management and Existing Investors Zero Infinity Partners (ZIP) and CIV; Brings Total Funding to $17 Million in Just 12 Months, Making It One of the Fastest-Funded Distributed Energy Resource Companies to Date
...
HOUSTON, Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AGent Energy, a trailblazing developer of AI-driven distributed power plants, today announced it has closed an $11 million Series Seed financing co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, with participation from Intrepid Investment Management and existing investors CIV and Zero Infinity Partners (ZIP). The round follows a $6 million financing from CIV and ZIP, which closed within two months of founding, bringing AGent's total funding to $17 million in its first 12 months. It's a striking vote of confidence in behind-the-meter generation as the next great frontier of U.S. energy infrastructure.
...
"Twelve months ago, AGent was an idea backed by two investors who saw what we saw: 200+ GW of the most reliable generation in America sitting idle behind the meter," said Stephanie Hendricks, CEO and Co-Founder of AGent. "Closing $17 million in our first year reflects both the urgency of the grid reliability challenge and the speed at which our team executes. With Spero, MassMutual Ventures, and Intrepid joining CIV and ZIP, we now have the partners and capital to bring this dispatchable capacity to the markets that need it most."
...
"The grid doesn't need to wait five years for new steel in the ground. The capacity is already there, and AGent has built the intelligence layer to unlock it. Stephanie and her team have moved faster than any company we've seen in this space, and we're proud to co-lead their Series Seed round," said Stephen Wemple of Spero Ventures.
...
In connection with the
...
, Stephen Wemple of Spero Ventures will join AGent's board of directors, and Aram Ouligian of MassMutual Ventures will join as a board observer.

AGent Energy, a developer of AI-driven distributed power plants, has successfully closed an $11 million Series Seed financing round. This new capital, co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, brings the company's total funding to an impressive $17 million within its first year of operation. The investment signals strong confidence in AGent's innovative approach to enhancing the stability of America's strained energy infrastructure using existing assets.
...
The recent funding round was co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, with notable participation from Intrepid Investment Management and existing investors CIV and Zero Infinity Partners. According to CEO Stephanie Hendricks, this capital reflects both the urgency of the grid reliability challenge and the team's rapid execution. The strong backing from prominent investors underscores the market's belief in AGent's mission and business model.

results.title: AGent Energy raises $11M to turn idle backup generators into grid capacity | Dealroom.co
highlights: What's the deal? AGent Energy, a Houston-based startup that integrates backup generators into the grid during emergencies, raised $11 million in seed funding co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures. Intrepid Investment Management and existing investors CIV and Zero Infinity Partners joined the round, which ranks among the largest seed rounds ever for a US transportation and energy startup — above the 97th percentile.

AGent Energy has raised $11 million in Series Seed financing, co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, bringing total capital to $17 million within its first 12 months. The funding accelerates AGent’s strategy to turn existing backup generators at commercial, industrial, and mission-critical facilities into AI-orchestrated distributed power plants that can be rapidly dispatched into wholesale power markets.
...
As part of the round, Spero Ventures’ Stephen Wemple will join AGent’s board, and MassMutual Ventures’ Aram Ouligian will serve as a board observer, adding institutional oversight and sector expertise to guide the next phase of growth. For energy users, utilities, and grid operators, AGent’s AI-based platform represents a near-term alternative to traditional large-scale generation buildout, offering dispatchable capacity that can respond in minutes and potentially reduce the risk of blackouts while improving asset economics for facility owners.
